title: Stoway
description: Advanced & customizable Roblox inventory/hotbar system with robust item instance tracking.
longDescription: Stoway is a flexible and feature-rich inventory and hotbar system designed for Roblox experiences. It provides developers with a robust framework to manage player items, offering deep customization for various gameplay needs, from simple backpacks to complex, data-driven inventories

title: Combat System
description: A very very early modular combat system for M1s, stuns, skills and armor states.
longDescription: A very very early build of a modular approach to combat so it can plug into anything with melee, battlegrounds, rpgs, or anything with M1s in general. Strict states mean hits never linger after stun, with cancelable skills, hyper armor skills that deal damage without getting stunned, super hyper armor skills that also take no damage in this state, plus ragdolling and R6 support. Built to pair with my custom animation service.
keyFeatures: Hyper armor skills (damage, can't be stunned)
Super hyper armor skills (no stun, no damage taken)

title: Projectile
description: All-in-one Roblox projectile system with custom tracer and hitscan.
longDescription: Projectile is a custom all-in-one projectile system based on https://devforum.roblox.com/t/projectile-an-all-in-one-projectile-system-10/3932599 with SwiftCast-style logic. Everything is custom-built and lightweight, using only SignalPlus and QuickNet as dependencies. Includes tracer and hitscan support plus demo effects.

title: Roblox MovementSystem
description: A Roblox movement system with FSM strict transitions to keep track of character states.
longDescription: A more controlled and memory first approach to tracking and keeping up with a players character states during movement. FSM helps me achieve a rigid approach to movement so that there are expected outcomes for each state.
keyFeatures: Easy to keep track of memory

title: Asymmetrical Systems
description: Round, kit and map logic plus cmdr admin, all event based with zero loop checking.
longDescription: Full game loop for asymmetrical games. Rounds run themselves, kits hand out characters with abilities, perks and status effects, maps load and clean up between rounds, and cmdr covers admin commands with api endpoints for debugging and logging. Everything talks through signalplus events so nothing sits in a loop checking state, and character rigs stay out of replicatedstorage until they are needed.
keyFeatures: Character kits with abilities and perks
API endpoints for debugging and logging
No character rig spam in replicatedstorage

title: Weapon Framework
description: A gun framework built on my own projectile system with batched networking & raycasts
longDescription: Takes the usual loadout, input, network and validation flow and structures it properly. Shooting runs on my projectile system with per frame raycast batching based on fire rate, tiny network packets, proper visual replication, and the server double checking fire rate on every packet. Mix of opensourced and self made optimizations.
keyFeatures: Per frame raycast batching based on fire rate
Server checks fire rate on every packet

title: AnimateService
description: A drop-in replacement for the stock Animate script with layered priorities and marker-driven anims.
longDescription: A custom animation service that replaces the stock Roblox Animate script. Copy the services into StarterPlayerScripts, drag your animations under the script, and it handles the rest with a priority stack from Core locomotion up through Action layers for arms, M1s and dashes, skills and blocks, all the way to stun, ragdoll and death. Supports R6 and R15, warms the cache with preloading, reuses tracks from a loaded bin so nothing leaks, and fires hitreg, sfx and shake from animation markers. Built to pair with my combat system.
keyFeatures: Priority stack from Core to Action4
M1s, dashes, skills, stuns and ragdolls on call
Preloaded cache plus reused tracks with no leaks

title: MannequinSystem
description: This system supports custom mannequins, a great way to showcase different outfits in specific locations!
longDescription: Using this system can you help with custom locations, custom themes, custom outfits, and a whole room to just explore, configure and expand.
